name: Immanence of Set — 1 Basic — Whisper of the Sands

system.description:
The shared blood of Set that sings in the veins of all his children creates a bond between them, letting a Setite share his thoughts with servants and childer no matter their distance. Unlike Setite Sorcery paths, Immanence of Set powers do not always require blood expenditure or a Willpower challenge — each power notes what it requires. This power lets the sorcerer communicate with his network across the known world and set plans in motion from hundreds of leagues away.

The player spends one Blood Trait and makes a Social Challenge (Manipulation/Leadership) against a difficulty of 6 Traits. On success, the vampire may communicate with any of his progeny or ghouls no matter how far away; each success allows one additional target to receive the message (all targets receive the same message). The communication lasts one turn and may consist of no more than two short sentences; the link may be maintained for further turns by spending a Willpower Trait each turn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three
system.prerequisites: Setite Sorcery (Immanence of Set); a Follower of Set in good standing with his temple
